name: od-scroll-film
title: Scroll Film
description: Turn a user's idea into a long-form, scroll-driven cinematic story site: one continuous narrative told through pinned scenes, scrubbed reveals, parallax depth, and chapter transitions, choreographed with generated GSAP ScrollTrigger code and delivered as a single self-contained HTML file.
credits: Chapter-card kicker/progress-rail scrollytelling convention after the common Pudding.cool / NYT long-form scroll pattern — original implementation, no source copied.
Pin + scale-through scene handoff after the velar-luxury-real-estate house precedent (plugins/_official/examples/velar-luxury-real-estate) — same repository, reimplemented generically.

useCase.query: Generate a long-form scroll-driven cinematic story site from this idea: {{idea}}. Derive 5-9 narrative beats, choreograph each as a pinned/scrubbed/parallax/reveal scene with generated GSAP ScrollTrigger code, add chapter transitions and a persistent progress cue, respect prefers-reduced-motion, and ship as one self-contained index.html with zero network requests.

inputs.name: idea
inputs.label: Your idea
inputs.placeholder: A founder's origin story for a solar farm startup, told as one continuous scroll...
